title: The last undead rebuilt in 3D
changes: The crawler, the mist wraith, the Bone Bride and the Hollow King are now built as 3D models and drawn as pixel art: a half skeleton dragging itself on its arms, a hovering hood of see-through mist with a cold core, a bridal dress with its red sash, and the Hollow King's crown and cape.
White robes and dresses keep their folds instead of glaring, and sashes show on robed monsters. Same size on screen and no cost to performance.
